title: Rubber EVA foam black or brown (3mm and 6mm)
description:
Rubber EVA foam black or brown (3mm and 6mm)

DESCRIPTION
Quality: Eva Foam
Thickness: 3mm or 6mm
Dimension: 9 x 14 inches (24cm x 36cm)
Color: Black or Brown

USAGE
Component for Shoes, Sandals, Bags, and Accessories

(ATTENTION) PACKAGING:
* A maximum of 5 Sheets (assorted colors) per order is the standard packaging
* Please make a separate order if will exceed 5 Sheets

DISCLAIMER:
* Colors of the leather may vary per production batch
* No Return /No Refund/ No Cancellation of orders once confirmed and Cut

*Cutting is done manually. It can not be perfected.

Please be guided accordingly. Thank you!

❌ No Bogus Buyers Please
❌ No shipouts on Sundays

Note that VisMin to Luzon delivery lead time is usually 1-2 weeks. Delivery may take longer during busy seasons, sales promotions, and during inclement weather conditions like typhoons.

Sellers do not have control over shipping and delivery schedules. We cannot tell when your order will be delivered. NO RUSH ORDERS. Please do not order if you need your items to arrive very soon. Take note of the standard delivery lead time.

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Cancellation or alteration of orders are NOT ALLOWED after we have prepared and packed your order. Please make sure that your added to cart items are in CORRECT quantity, color, size, etc.
- Make sure that you input the correct delivery address and receiver information to avoid returns and delivery problems.
- NO RETURNS / EXCHANGE for items that need to be cut (sold by meter) as these are especially cut for you and cannot be sold to other customers when returned. Refunds/Returns are only allowed when the mistake is on the part of the seller.
